description: This file defines a REST controller for handling authentication functionalities such as login and token refresh within a Spring Boot application. It manages JWT token issuance and refresh operations, utilizing Spring Security components.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller managing authentication endpoints such as login and token refresh, utilizing JWT for token management.

methods.name: AuthController
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies: AuthenticationManager, UserDetailsService, JwtService.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login, authenticates credentials, and returns access and refresh tokens.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Handles token refresh requests, generating a new access token based on a valid refresh token.
